'''Loyat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who was the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Arho]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
When Loyat began her training on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], she killed several other Sith, but was never punished for it when [[Darth Arho]], who would later ascend to [[Darth Baras]]'s seat on the [[Dark Council]] after his execution by the [[Empire's Wrath|second]] [[Emperor's Wrath]], selected her as his apprentice.<ref name="Crystal Ball" />

{{GameLS}}
In the later stages of the [[Galactic War]], Loyat participated in her master's [[Battle of Ilum|invasion]] of the planet [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. She was soon confronted by a Republic strike team. She arrogantly boasted to her opponents that she would crush them. She called on Arho to aid in destroying the interlopers but her master did not come to her, so she fought her opponents regardless. After a long duel, Loyat was beaten and forced to surrender. She then questioned Arho's teachings, before she was taken into custody.<ref name="Crystal Ball" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Loyat first appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the apprentice of the Darth Arho. After defeating her, the player has the option of either executing Loyat or arresting her.<ref name="Crystal Ball" />
